title: Odile and the Bakery
author: L. M. Almeida
blurb: Rosalind Eastwick, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the person in the mirror first before the bakery lease runs out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
